svg.text: Spectrum: block size and window; each map column is one block.
View: Linear, Power or PSD, RMS or Peak, colour scale Linear or dB (Log); redraws without recomputing.
Tacho Tracking: RPM Tracked (axis in rpm) or Free Run (axis in time), Step, Sweep, Hysteresis.
The map: frequency across, speed or time along, colour is the amplitude. A line is a tone, a bright patch a resonance.
